source_format: XML alone, used as an audit reference only
point_semantics: head bounding-box center, not a ground contact point
input_inventory: all currently visible, non-occluded agents; never restricted by future availability

input_fields.sequence_id: recording identity; not a verified physical-site ID
input_fields.observation_frames: current and past raw frame indices
input_fields.positions: N by K by 2, image-pixel box centers; invalid entries zero-masked
input_fields.history_mask: N by K, observed visibility at sampled past frames
input_fields.history_complete: N, visibility at every raw frame in the past interval
input_fields.in_bounds_mask: N by K, valid boxes within nominal 1920 by 1080; diagnostic flag, no clipping
input_fields.velocities: N by K by 2, backward differences in pixels per raw frame
input_fields.velocity_mask: false initially and across any raw-frame visibility gap

separate_label_fields.future_frames: requested positive offsets from query frame
separate_label_fields.complete_target: loss/evaluation only; requires full contiguous raw history/future span
